tagline.en: The Niagara Thruway, and a toll that outlived its bonds
tagline.zh: 尼亚加拉收费高速：债券还清后仍在收费

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-90, the New York State Thruway, in Buffalo
start.zh: 布法罗，与纽约州收费高速 I-90 相接

end.zh: 通往安大略省的刘易斯顿－昆斯顿大桥

en: I-190 is the Niagara Thruway: it leaves I-90 in Buffalo, runs north along the Niagara River through the city, crosses onto Grand Island and off it again, and continues to Niagara Falls and the Canadian border at the Lewiston–Queenston Bridge. The odd hundreds digit marks a spur, and it is one — it never comes back to I-90. Parts of it were laid along the former rights of way of the Lehigh Valley Railroad and the Erie Canal.

It is still a toll road in part, which makes it unusual among urban auxiliary Interstates. The Grand Island crossings charge in one direction each — northbound at the south bridge, southbound at the north one — so a driver pays once whichever way they cross the island. As of 1 January 2026 the rate for a car is $1.00 with a New York E-ZPass and $1.75 without.
zh: I-190 就是尼亚加拉收费高速：它自布法罗离开 I-90，沿尼亚加拉河穿城北上，跨上大岛又跨下来，继续通往尼亚加拉瀑布城，以及刘易斯顿－昆斯顿大桥处的加拿大边境。奇数百位标示支线，它也确实是——从未回到 I-90。其中部分路段铺在利哈伊谷铁路与伊利运河的旧线用地上。
它至今仍有一部分收费，这在城市辅助州际公路中相当少见。大岛的两处跨河桥各只在一个方向收费——南桥收北行、北桥收南行——所以无论从哪个方向穿过大岛，司机都只付一次。截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日，小客车持纽约 E-ZPass 为 1.00 美元，无卡为 1.75 美元。

en: The road was built by the New York State Thruway Authority, not the state highway department. Work began in 1953 on two segments — South Ogden Street to Porter Avenue in downtown Buffalo, and Beaver Island Parkway to West River Road on Grand Island — and on 16 July 1954 construction started on linking the two existing two-lane bridges across the Niagara. The Grand Island section opened on 8 November 1956, the Buffalo sections on 30 July 1959, and the rest was finished by 1964. The 1935 South Grand Island Bridge was joined by a twin span on 11 October 1962; each carries two lanes of a 3,400-foot crossing 93 feet above the river.

The tolls are the part people remember. The enabling law said they would come off once the construction bonds were repaid, which happened in 1996 — but in 1991 the state had started using I-190 toll revenue to pay for maintaining I-84 downstate, and the tolls stayed. They lasted another decade, until a lawsuit by the Buffalo developer Carl Paladino and campaign pledges from both candidates in the 2006 governor's race forced the issue: the Thruway Authority voted on 30 October 2006 to stop collecting in Buffalo and to hand I-84 back. The Grand Island booths survived twelve more years, replaced by cashless gantries in March 2018.
zh: 这条路由纽约州收费高速管理局修建，而非州公路部门。工程于 1953 年在两段上开工——布法罗市中心的南奥格登街至波特大道，以及大岛上的比弗岛公园路至西河路——1954 年 7 月 16 日又开始施工，把尼亚加拉河上两座既有的双车道桥连起来。大岛段于 1956 年 11 月 8 日通车，布法罗各段于 1959 年 7 月 30 日通车，其余部分到 1964 年完工。1935 年建成的南大岛桥在 1962 年 10 月 11 日增建了一座孪生桥；两桥各承载两条车道，跨河长 3,400 英尺，高出水面 93 英尺。

人们记住的是收费这件事。授权法律规定，建设债券还清后即应停止收费，这在 1996 年就已发生——但 1991 年起，该州开始用 I-190 的通行费收入支付州南部 I-84 的养护，收费于是留了下来。它又持续了十年，直到布法罗开发商卡尔·帕拉迪诺提起诉讼，加上 2006 年州长竞选两位主要候选人都作出承诺，才逼出结果：收费高速管理局于 2006 年 10 月 30 日表决停止在布法罗收费，并将 I-84 交还。大岛的收费亭又存续了十二年，于 2018 年 3 月被不停车收费门架取代。

why.en: The Niagara Thruway was financed by Thruway Authority bonds rather than a single appropriation; the record shows that the bonds were retired in 1996 but no construction total for I-190 has been published.
why.zh: 尼亚加拉收费高速由收费高速管理局发行债券融资，而非单笔财政拨款；记录只显示债券于 1996 年偿清，未见公布 I-190 的建设总额。

timeline.en: Construction begins on the first two segments of the Niagara Thruway.
timeline.zh: 尼亚加拉收费高速首两段开工。

timeline.en: A twin span opens beside the 1935 South Grand Island Bridge.
timeline.zh: 1935 年建成的南大岛桥旁增建的孪生桥通车。

timeline.en: The construction bonds are repaid, but the tolls stay on.
timeline.zh: 建设债券偿清，但收费并未取消。

timeline.en: The Thruway Authority votes on 30 October to end tolling in Buffalo.
timeline.zh: 10 月 30 日，收费高速管理局表决终止布法罗段收费。

timeline.en: The Grand Island tollbooths are replaced by cashless gantries.
timeline.zh: 大岛收费亭被不停车收费门架取代。
